mainEntity.name: What should homeowners prepare before consulting a contractor about a granny flat?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before scheduling a design consultation, gather key details about your property and living requirements. Determine who will live in the space and what specific mobility aids, privacy needs, or daily routines they have. Locate your property survey to see lot boundaries, easements, and setbacks if you are considering building outward. Outline a target budget and assemble a wishlist of necessary rooms, such as a kitchenette, laundry closet, or walk-in shower. Having these details ready helps contractors evaluate layout options and produce realistic initial estimates for your home addition.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather your property survey, identify required accessibility or privacy features, set a preliminary budget, and outline necessary spaces like kitchenettes or walk-in showers.
